refreshToken.title: MobilityData refresh token
refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token from mobilitydatabase.org → account settings. Exchanged at runtime for short-lived access tokens. Required; the integration disables itself when unset.

steps: Sign up / sign in at mobilitydatabase.org.
Open the Account Details screen in your account.
Copy the long-lived refresh token shown there.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: The refresh token is long-lived; it is exchanged at runtime for a short-lived access token valid for one hour.

includeRtFeeds.description: Surface GTFS-Realtime producer URLs in the catalog (URLs only — RT bytes are not proxied).

includeGbfsFeeds.description: Surface GBFS systems in the catalog so a future bike/scooter overlay can consume them.

apiBaseUrl.description: MobilityData API base URL. Override for staging or self-hosted mirrors.
